feedback_decisions.feedback_item: Battery mass-energy inconsistency: 341W x 0.5h = 171Wh not 1000Wh, 1000Wh/2.92kg = 342Wh/kg vs LiFePO4 pack ~90-110Wh/kg
feedback_decisions.why: Pack claim violates everyday pack scale and decides mass margin and runtime. Must require recompute of sortie energy from power and duration and pack mass from cited pack specific energy, with joint total reconciliation.

feedback_decisions.feedback_item: Actuator force with friction through 4:1 linkage unproven (E56 failed) and lift energy 2400J vs ~155J useful (15x overhead)
feedback_decisions.why: Travel without force with friction leaves dump unproven and lift energy overhead signals model error. Must require pivot geometry plus linkage force with friction and useful-vs-input energy check.

feedback_decisions.feedback_item: Dump kinematics and tip moment unproven: 0.45m stowed frame to 1.0m lip, 0.50m hopper, 0.30m overhang, tip factor 4.06 vs 7.1 earlier
feedback_decisions.why: Tip factor swing shows moment-arm sensitivity. Must require fixed pivot geometry, overhang distance, wheelbase reactions and reconciled safety factor with sketch.

feedback_decisions.feedback_item: Dimensioned stowed 1.0x0.5x0.5m envelope missing: 300mm wheels + stowed 900mm mast + 1050mm hopper travel, sketches E11/E46/E57 deployed only
feedback_decisions.why: Deployed topology alone cannot prove start-box fit. Must require dimensioned stowed sketch showing frame, wheels, stowed mast and lowered hopper within limits.

feedback_decisions.feedback_item: Mass integration O1 and runtime from pack at full load unproven (E58/E59 failed)
feedback_decisions.why: Without joint mass table and runtime at full load, mass compliance and sortie closure stay open. Must require integrated total and runtime with evidence ids before vote.

feedback_decisions.feedback_item: Sealed-box thermal 22K rise E53 / 0.00332 m3/s for 80W E52 closed but IP65 dust claim only generic E27-E29, plus FPV latency / stopping 0.15m
feedback_decisions.why: Thermal bound is closed and dust-seal detail plus latency are test tuning, not acceptance blockers. Retain current sealed-box plus fan plus dual-link heartbeat behavior with no prompt acceptance change.

feedback_decisions.feedback_item: Traction/cutting/contact/torque E10, sensor power E47, hopper volume 0.0111m3 E49, overall physical plausibility and RASSOR distinction
feedback_decisions.why: Supported and plausible with no conservation/load/signal violation. Retain as-is with no prompt change.

per_section.heading: ## 2. Roles / ### Priya — Power, Avionics and Lunar Environment Engineer
per_section.diagnosis: Priya role owns power sizing and enclosure but does not force energy-mass consistency check against cited pack scale, so off-scale pack passed to proposal and joint total.
per_section.direction: Add to Priya ownership: derive sortie energy from budget power and duration, check implied specific energy against cited pack datasheet, post corrected mass and runtime with evidence ids, and reconcile with joint total.
per_section.explains: E48/E34/E50 and O4 battery mass-energy inconsistency

per_section.heading: ## 2. Roles / ### Sam — Structure, Mass and Material Handling Engineer
per_section.diagnosis: Sam role owns hopper, dump and envelope but does not force pivot geometry, linkage force with friction, tip arms, and dimensioned stowed fit, so travel plausible but force, stability and fit stay unproven.
per_section.direction: Add to Sam ownership: show pivot positions, guide travel and linkage force with friction, show tip reactions with overhang for raised load, and post stowed dimensioned sketch proving fit; reconcile changed safety factor with stated geometry change.
per_section.explains: E56/E60/E55/E51/E46/E57 and O1/O2 dump and envelope gaps

per_section.heading: ## 4. Meeting protocol
per_section.diagnosis: Protocol requires evidence and survive-strongest-objection voting but allowed early ready vote and proposal carryover without joint mass, force, stability and envelope evidence, so cap arrived with blocks open.
per_section.direction: Strengthen protocol: require cited evidence ids for key claims, require joint mass table reconciliation on proposal change, require lift-force, tip-geometry and stowed-sketch evidence to close related blocks, and require withholding ready vote while assigned blocks stay open.
per_section.explains: Meeting closed without consensus with 1 ready to 3 not-ready and O1/O2/O4 open; early Mara vote cycles 2-3

per_section.heading: ## 5. Criteria
per_section.diagnosis: Criteria states work physically and buildable with shop methods but does not distinguish acceptance proofs from test tuning, so dust-seal detail and latency risk being treated as blockers on resubmittal.
per_section.direction: Clarify that buildable requires closed mass-energy, lift-force, stability and envelope proofs with evidence, while seal implementation detail and link latency tuning remain verification tuning, not vote blockers when bounded.
per_section.explains: Sealed-box thermal closed vs generic IP claim and FPV latency items marked no acceptance change
